name: A Baying of Gnolls
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...

If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
narrative.objectives: Kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Redridge Mystics, then return to Verner Osgood.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for all your help, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
